artifact_partitions.rule: The 38 La Poste GP rows become 33 distinct postal assertions only and have no geometry authority; BL/MF rows remain excluded.
Only fixed geo.api.gouv.fr coordinates enter the geometry artifact; source, date, licence, digest, shared and multi-Ligne-5 surfaces, territory exclusions and derived class remain visible.
No address, building, parcel, recipient, customer or land-rights record is published.
